messages:
Anya: Quick notewe observed a noticeable tail regression after enabling continuous-batching on Private (eu-central) nodes. 95p +35ms, occasional spikes past 200ms SLO on T4-sized VMs.
Devin: When did that go out? deploy id?
InfraBot: deploy d-903 completed 1763455800 (private eu-central). Canary 0%->100% over 25m.
Anya: Right after d-903. I grabbed a few profiler dumps and runtime traces. High-level: kernel selection sometimes falls back to the generic kernel for short sequences instead of the fused/int8 kernel; batching queues form skewed batches (long requests dominating token counts); KV cache eviction rate spikes under concurrency causing extra KV fetches.
Anya: Quick profiler excerpt: 
```
sample: light-scan
kernel_select_path_avg_ms: 17.4
avg_tokens_per_batch: 610
token_budget_target: 1080
kv_evictions_per_min: 22
queue_wait_ms_p50: 6.2
queue_wait_ms_p95: 48.9
```
Chris: Ok. For Private (constrained HW) we should try conservative overrides: lower token_budget_target and cap max_batch_tokens; prefer fused kernel on t4s up to a higher seq cutoff.
Mara: Also saw shared_lru thrash on smaller RAM configs. If the kv LRU is too tight we get cascading misses under spike. Suggest a reserve_pct and lower concurrent batches.
Devin: Draft override YAML for VPC/private clusters:
```
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  queue_policy: token_aware
  token_budget_target: 512
  max_batch_tokens: 1536
  max_concurrent_batches: 4
  token_aware:
    max_wait_ms: 12
kv_cache:
  strategy: shared_lru
  reserve_pct: 20
kernel_selection:
  overrides:
    - hw_tag: t4
      prefer: int8_fused
      seq_cutoff: 64
```
Anya: token_aware matches my thinkingit holds tiny requests briefly so they can join larger ones and avoid skew. Add max_wait_ms to bound latency for tiny requests.
Chris: Good. Also add kernel_override logging so we can trace why a kernel was chosen. If the selector misfires we need the decision path in traces.
Jia: Note: kernel selection sometimes pays a cold penalty when kernel build cache is missing on private nodes. We should add a kernel warmup step in the private deploy pipeline to preload kernels for pinned models.
Mara: I'll repro on a T4 VM with a synthetic 50/50 short/long mix and post before/after numbers. Expect ~30-40m.
Anya: Action items:
- Chris/Devin: apply YAML override as a 5% canary in eu-central private cluster.
- Jia: add kernel warmup job to private deployment pipeline (preload fused/int8 kernels for pinned models).
- Mara: run local repro and upload perf traces.
- Devin: collect perf traces and open ENGRT ticket labeled vpc-batching-regression.
InfraBot: Creating ticket ENGRT-9634 and scheduling 5% canary at 10:00 UTC tomorrow.
Devin: I'll run canary and share traces. Posting a couple of perf probes (token distribution hist, kernel_select logs) after the canary.
Chris: One caution: token_aware can slightly increase median for very small requests if max_wait_ms is too high. Keep max_wait_ms conservative (<=12ms).
Mara: Repro started. Quick note: with current defaults local T4 saw p95 +42ms; will test override now.
Anya: Thanks. If canary looks good we'll keep override as the default for Private while we fix kernel selector heuristics in the runtime.
Devin: Roger, will update this thread with traces and the ticket link.
